# Unlimited Copies Takaka

> Commercial printer and copy shop in Takaka, Tasman, New Zealand. Also a postal courier pickup and drop-off point (gold-coin fee; street address on Commercial Street — not Rural Delivery).

- Website: https://unlimitedcopies.co.nz/
- Email: ulc@actrix.co.nz
- Phone: +64 3 525 8355
- Address: 29 Commercial Street, Takaka 7110, New Zealand
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; closed weekends
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Unlimited-Copies-100050000846281/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://unlimitedcopies.co.nz/) — shop overview, contact, and hours
- [Services](https://unlimitedcopies.co.nz/#services) — commercial printing, scanning, finishing, and postal pickup

## Services

- **Commercial printing in Takaka** — digital colour and black-and-white printing, photocopying, scanning, laminating, and finishing; business stationery, flyers, booklets, posters, and reports up to SRA3
- **Postal / courier pickup in Takaka** — pickup and drop-off during shop hours; gold-coin fee for pickup use; street address (not RD) often avoids higher Rural Delivery courier rates

## Contact

Prefer email for print jobs and file attachments: ulc@actrix.co.nz

Use the contact form on the website to send a message with attachments.

**Not an RD address** — 29 Commercial Street, Takaka is a town street address suitable for courier pickup without Rural Delivery surcharges.
